pattern: Independent existing builds are polled with a recurring schedule
experience: A coordinator repeatedly woke on a five-minute schedule to check unrelated top-level threads, despite only needing their completion.

setup.context: You are the coordinator thread. build-a and build-b are existing independent top-level threads on this environment, already building. Neither is an owned delegated task. No other work is ready.

t3_thread_watch.next: Completion wakes this thread. Continue independent work, or end your turn. Do not poll or schedule checks.

prompt: Watch build-a and build-b. When both finish, compare their actual changes. There is nothing else to do until then.

pattern: Owned delegates already provide completion wakes
experience: Generic watches should not duplicate owned delegate completion delivery.

setup.context: You already launched owned delegate task-1. It is running. Its tool result says: Completion wakes this thread. Do not wait on it or poll it. Continue other work, and end your turn when none is left. There is no independent work available.
